text.zh_cn: 近防炮装在核心强化槽；防空导弹发射器是另一层防御，出航前检查装填。
text.en_us: Install CIWS in a core enhancement slot. An anti-air missile launcher provides another layer; check its ammunition before sailing.

text.zh_cn: 自动模式控制近防炮、防空导弹与战斗机自动升空。自动模式键默认为 H，用界面状态确认是否开启。
text.en_us: Auto mode controls CIWS, anti-air missiles and automatic fighter launch. Toggle it with H by default and check its HUD indicator.

text.zh_cn: 自动防空需要合适目标和可用装备；大口径炮开火或飞机起降后，近防炮会短暂停火。
text.en_us: Automatic defenses need a suitable target and usable equipment. CIWS pauses briefly after large guns fire or aircraft launch or land.

text.zh_cn: 目标进入有效范围后自动防御才会响应；幻翼仅用于代表空中威胁。
text.en_us: Automatic defense responds when a valid target enters range. The phantom only represents an air threat.
